svg.title: TabPFN v2.5 vs Mitra
svg.desc: Model A: TabPFN v2.5 - classifier. Model B: Mitra - classifier. Symbols in shapes: B: ensemble members (batch); n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; F (A): feature groups; F (B): features; E: embedding width; n_test: test rows (the rows being predicted); S: support rows; Q: query rows; D: model width (512). Abbreviations: MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); LayerNorm: layer normalisation; KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads). How to read: model A, its stages and its fact values; model B, its stages and its fact values; stages are paired by kind and attention axis, in order, not by name: a pair is the same kind of block in the same place, not necessarily the same design; matched: same kind and axis, and the same number of stacked blocks; N vs M: same kind and axis, with N stacked blocks in A and M in B; only A / only B: a stage with no counterpart in the other model; facts: shared (the same value), different, or one side (reported by one model only, shown as --); on each card: × N stacked blocks and the axis its attention runs over, then its output shape; top right, its exact parameter count.
